issues: The source's third-house five-degree cusp boundaries must not be implemented without historically correct house computations and explicit end-point inequalities.
The Mars/brothers, Moon/sisters division is a historical astrological stereotype, not an empirical sex predictor.
The optional lunar node included among fruitful or barren planets has unclear glyph/operator proof in the first edition and must remain optional and unresolved.
The claimed many/few/none and moderate sibling categories have no objective count thresholds or registered accuracy.
Age at birth, family planning, fertility, infant mortality, marriage patterns, contraception, geography and socioeconomic conditions are strong non-astrological family-size factors.
Fruitful planets/signs and barren planets/signs combine as conditional paired prerequisites; mixed combinations permit a third ambiguous result.
Mercury is explicitly said to change according to its configuration with purported fruitful or barren planets.
All twelve sign classifications and their periodic imagery are author assertions, not medical claims about fertility.
The Scorpio exception (historically called fruitful despite Mars rulership) prevents a ruler-only fertility shortcut.
An exact aspect priority chain, partile over platick, has no specified numerical tolerance on these pages.
No real sibling birth record, independent chart information, prospective outcomes or blind statistical tests were checked.
Printed CXIX on sibling condition begins below another divider PDF600 and is not admitted as sibling count evidence.
The original source was visually inspected and clause-level paraphrases stored, but no full diplomatic transcription or independent astrological efficacy was established.
